screen.m4cne.title: World map settings
screen.m4cne.back.tooltip: Return to the previous menu. ESC always closes the whole world map.
screen.m4cne.input.enter_confirm: Press Enter to apply the typed value.
screen.m4cne.page.world_map.tooltip: Rendering, shading, performance, layers and the map HUD.
screen.m4cne.page.radar.tooltip: How entity markers are drawn: merged per chunk, individual dots or individual icons.
screen.m4cne.page.waypoints.tooltip: Manage the waypoint list and recycle bin, and configure the marker display.
screen.m4cne.page.preload.tooltip: Generate a chunk region with the chunk loading engine and import the result into the world map.
screen.m4cne.page.overlays.tooltip: Chunk grid, biomes, slime chunks, ore veins and chunk information queries.
screen.m4cne.page.minimap_hud.tooltip: General options, border and extra information of the in-game HUD.
screen.m4cne.page.minimap_layout.tooltip: Pick the corner and the scale of the minimap on a preview of the game window.
screen.m4cne.page.compass_layout.tooltip: Position the compass around the screen centre line and adjust its size, icons and background.
screen.m4cne.page.presets.tooltip: Save, apply and delete up to ten world map setting presets.
screen.m4cne.section.layer: Automatic or manual surface / cave layer
screen.m4cne.section.preload_import: Import preloaded chunks and draw the map
screen.m4cne.setting.map_shading.tooltip: Colour the map by the sampled slope so mountains and valleys become visible.
screen.m4cne.setting.map_day_night.toolt: Dim the surface map at night and show block light in caves.
screen.m4cne.setting.map_height_color.to: Use the sampled surface height to brighten high ground and darken low ground.
screen.m4cne.setting.map_smooth.tooltip: Use linear filtering; disable to keep crisp map pixels.
screen.m4cne.setting.invert_scroll.toolt: Off (default): rolling up zooms in. The map and the settings list now use the same, non-inverted direction.
screen.m4cne.setting.overscan.tooltip: Extra area rendered around the canvas: larger values make panning smoother but cost more per rebuild.
screen.m4cne.setting.shading_strength.to: Strength of the relief shading, 0 disables it.
screen.m4cne.setting.height_blend.toolti: How strongly the surface height changes the map brightness.
screen.m4cne.setting.light_intensity.too: How strongly sky light and block light affect the map colours.
screen.m4cne.setting.chunks_per_tick.too: Maximum number of chunks re-sampled per client tick.
screen.m4cne.setting.rescan_seconds.tool: How often recorded chunks are checked for changes.
screen.m4cne.setting.render_scale.toolti: Texture pixels relative to the on-screen size; lower values are faster.
screen.m4cne.setting.rebuild_interval.to: Minimum time between two map texture rebuilds.
screen.m4cne.setting.settle_ms.tooltip: How long the camera has to rest before the texture is rebuilt; dragging only scales the existing texture.
screen.m4cne.setting.layer_mode.tooltip: Automatic picks the layer from the player height, manual always uses the configured layer.
screen.m4cne.setting.manual_layer.toolti: Layer shown in manual switch mode.
screen.m4cne.setting.cave_offset.tooltip: Vertical offset of the sampled cave slice relative to the player.
screen.m4cne.setting.auto_cave_depth.too: Distance below the surface at which the map switches to the cave layer.
screen.m4cne.setting.hud_enabled.tooltip: When disabled the information box in the top left corner of the world map is no longer drawn; every other overlay stays visible.
screen.m4cne.setting.hud_coordinates.too: Show the player coordinates in the map HUD.
screen.m4cne.setting.hud_chunk_coordinat: Show the chunk the player is in.
screen.m4cne.setting.hud_scale.tooltip: Show the current map scale in the map HUD.
screen.m4cne.setting.hud_entity_totals.t: Show how many entities are inside the visible map area.
screen.m4cne.setting.hud_info_scale.tool: Scale of the map HUD text.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_enabled.toolt: Draw entity information on top of the world map.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_mode.tooltip: Merge into chunk statistics draws one marker per chunk, individual draws every entity.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_style.tooltip: Use coloured dots or the cached static icon of each entity type.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_icon_scale.to: Size of the independent entity icons.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_max_markers.t: Upper bound of independent markers drawn per frame.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_sample_interv: How often the visible entities are re-sampled.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_hostile.toolt: Include hostile mobs in the radar.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_passive.toolt: Include animals and other passive mobs.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_items.tooltip: Include items, projectiles and other non-living entities.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_click_info.to: Left clicking an entity marker highlights it and shows its name and coordinates.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_scale.tooltip: Size of merged markers and independent dots.
screen.m4cne.setting.radar_counts.toolti: Show the entity count next to a merged marker.
screen.m4cne.setting.waypoint_show.toolt: Draw waypoint markers on the world map.
screen.m4cne.setting.waypoint_names.tool: Draw the waypoint name below its marker.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_radius.tool: Preload radius in chunks, at most 400 chunks.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_shape.toolt: Switch the preload area between a square and a circle.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_center.tool: Use the world spawn, the player position or a marker placed on the map.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_freeze.tool: Freezes the game with the vanilla /tick freeze command while a task runs.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_show_range: Show the range on the map
Draw the preload outline and progress label on the world map.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_threads.too: Parallel chunk requests, capped at the hardware thread count; c2me handles them with its parallel engine.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_priority.to: Priority of the preload worker, five steps with the middle one as default.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_memory.tool: Memory budget of the task; the maximum follows the memory the game was given, with a safety buffer.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_import_mode: No import, import chunky's chunk data, or import the chunks this mod preloaded.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_import_budg: Upper bound of chunks read and sent per tick while importing.
screen.m4cne.setting.preload_import_auto: Only runs after a preload task finished or was cancelled by hand, never while it is paused.
screen.m4cne.setting.overlay_coordinates: Draw the chunk coordinates as (x, z) in the top left corner of every chunk; works without the chunk grid.
screen.m4cne.setting.overlay_heights.too: Append the sampled surface height as "z: <height>" to the chunk coordinate line.
screen.m4cne.setting.overlay_biome.toolt: Tint every recorded chunk with a stable colour derived from its biome.
screen.m4cne.setting.overlay_biome_opaci: Opacity of the biome overlay only.
screen.m4cne.setting.overlay_slime.toolt: Fill slime chunks with green diagonal stripes (requires the world seed).
screen.m4cne.setting.overlay_slime_opaci: Opacity of the slime chunk stripes only.
screen.m4cne.setting.overlay_ores.toolti: Show the material item of the most common ore of every visible chunk (a deepslate iron ore becomes raw iron, for example).
Chunks scanned for the ore overlay per tick; higher values may stutter.
screen.m4cne.setting.overlay_highlight.t: Highlight the chunk under the cursor and show its details.
screen.m4cne.setting.overlay_opacity.too: Opacity of the chunk grid, the chunk labels and the ore icons.
screen.m4cne.setting.query_highlight.too: Draw a yellow frame around the chunk of the last query.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_enabled.too: Show the in-game minimap or compass HUD (also toggled by its hotkey).
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_mode.toolti: Minimap draws the nearby terrain, compass draws the heading strip.
screen.m4cne.action.minimap_layout.toolt: Opens a third level menu: the canvas previews the game window and clicking a quadrant moves the minimap to that corner.
screen.m4cne.action.compass_layout.toolt: Opens a third level menu: the canvas previews the game window and clicking moves the compass centre to that spot.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_render_laye: Draw the HUD above or below other mod overlays; below lets other mods cover the minimap.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_hide_in_scr: Hide HUD while a screen is open
Hide the minimap / compass automatically while inventories, chests, JEI / EMI or other screens are open.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_size.toolti: Edge length of the square minimap in GUI pixels.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_border.tool: Draw a vanilla style frame around the HUD.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_coordinates: Show the player coordinates below the HUD.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_biome.toolt: Show the biome the player is standing in.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_chunk.toolt: Show the current chunk, its slime chunk state and entity count.
Scale of the HUD information lines.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_entities.to: Draw the nearby entity icons on the minimap (the entity radar target filters apply) and list the nearest target below the HUD.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_entity_rang: Maximum horizontal distance (blocks) of entities shown on the minimap; icons beyond the widget are pinned to its border.
Size of the entity icons and waypoint diamonds drawn on the minimap.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_waypoints.t: Draw the waypoints as diamonds in their own colour and list the nearest waypoint below the HUD.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_waypoint_ra: Maximum horizontal distance (blocks) of waypoints shown on the minimap.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_corner.tool: Corner the minimap is anchored to. Clicking the preview picks the quadrant directly.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_scale.toolt: Scale of the minimap; it grows away from its screen corner so it never leaves the window.
screen.m4cne.setting.minimap_margin.tool: Distance between the minimap and the screen border in GUI pixels.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_pos_x.toolt: Horizontal offset of the compass centre from the vertical centre line of the screen, in GUI pixels.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_pos_y.toolt: Vertical position of the compass centre, measured from the top edge of the screen.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_scale.toolt: Scale of the compass strip; it grows around its own centre point.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_width.toolt: Base width of the compass strip in GUI pixels; width changes expand both sides equally.
Size of the entity icons on the compass strip; it also scales the name, distance and merged count text below the icons.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_background_: Opacity of the compass strip background and its grey frame; 0 makes both fully transparent.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_entities.to: Draws entity icons on the compass strip using the entity radar target filters; an icon close to the heading line shows its name, horizontal distance and relative height.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_entity_rang: Maximum horizontal distance (blocks) of entities shown on the compass. Highlighted players ignore this limit.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_merge_pixel: Entity icons closer than this many pixels are merged into one marker that shows the merged count.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_waypoints.t: Draw the waypoints of the current dimension as diamonds in their own colour; a diamond close to the heading line shows its name and distance.
screen.m4cne.setting.compass_waypoint_ra: Maximum horizontal distance (blocks) of waypoints shown on the compass.
screen.m4cne.action.clear_cache.tooltip: Drop all sampled chunks and scan them again.
screen.m4cne.action.waypoint_here.toolti: Create a waypoint at the player position.
screen.m4cne.action.waypoint_center.tool: Create a waypoint at the centre of the map view.
screen.m4cne.action.waypoint_clear: Delete all waypoints of this world
screen.m4cne.action.waypoint_clear.toolt: Remove every stored waypoint of the current dimension.
screen.m4cne.preload.action.start.toolti: Start the preload with the current area and performance settings; stored progress is resumed.
screen.m4cne.preload.action.pause.toolti: Pause the task and release the chunk requests; the progress is kept.
screen.m4cne.preload.action.cancel.toolt: Cancel the task and drop the progress record and chunk cache; a second click confirms.
screen.m4cne.preload.action.import: Import and draw the map now
screen.m4cne.preload.action.import.toolt: Read the finished preload region according to the import mode and draw it on the world map.
screen.m4cne.preload.action.clear_marker: Clear the centre markers of this dimension
Delete every bright preload centre marker from the current dimension.
screen.m4cne.preload.center.marker: Mark the centre on the map

screen.m4cne.context.player_unhighlight: Remove the highlight of this player (%s)
screen.m4cne.action.query_run.tooltip: Query the chunk specified by the X/Z fields above.
screen.m4cne.action.query_player.tooltip: Query biome, slime state and ore veins of the player chunk.
screen.m4cne.action.query_center.tooltip: Query the chunk at the centre of the map view.
screen.m4cne.action.query_focus.tooltip: Move the map view to the last queried chunk.
screen.m4cne.action.query_clear.tooltip: Remove the query result and its highlight.
screen.m4cne.action.preset_save.tooltip: Store all current map settings in this preset slot.
screen.m4cne.action.preset_apply.tooltip: Load the settings stored in this preset slot.
screen.m4cne.action.preset_delete.toolti: Delete the settings stored in this preset slot.
screen.m4cne.action.reset_defaults.toolt: Reset every map setting to its default value.
screen.m4cne.label.waypoint_hint: Right click the world map to add a waypoint quickly.
screen.m4cne.label.preload_note: Map preload widens the actively sampled area and syncs it to the server.
screen.m4cne.label.preset_note: Presets are shown as a list with 10 slots and store the world map, HUD, radar, waypoint, overlay and minimap HUD settings.
screen.m4cne.label.radar_hint: Merged mode aggregates entities per chunk; individual mode splits every sampled entity.
screen.m4cne.label.hud_hotkeys: Hotkeys: %s toggles the HUD, %s switches minimap / compass, %s creates a waypoint.
screen.m4cne.label.hud_extra_hint: Hotkeys can be changed in Options -> Controls -> Key Binds.
screen.m4cne.label.minimap_layout_hint: The canvas previews the game window; click a quadrant to move the minimap to that corner.
screen.m4cne.label.minimap_layout_scale_: Scaling is anchored at the chosen corner, so the minimap stays inside the screen.
screen.m4cne.label.compass_layout_hint: The gold line is the vertical centre of the screen; the compass is placed relative to it.
screen.m4cne.label.compass_layout_scale_: The compass scales around its own centre and widens symmetrically on both sides.
screen.m4cne.label.compass_entity_hint: An icon near the centre line shows the entity name, its horizontal distance and the relative height right below the icon (^ higher, v lower, - level); this text scales with the entity icon scale slider.
screen.m4cne.label.compass_waypoint_hint: Waypoints are drawn as diamonds in their own colour; only waypoints within the configured range are shown.
screen.m4cne.label.minimap_marker_hint: The minimap draws entity icons and waypoint diamonds too, and lists the nearest entity and waypoint below the HUD.
screen.m4cne.status.player_highlighted: Player %s is now highlighted on the HUD
screen.m4cne.hud.chunk_info_not_slime: Chunk %s, %s - not a slime chunk - %s entities

screen.m4cne.hud_layout.compass_click_hi: Left click to move the centre of the compass there
screen.m4cne.preset.row.tooltip: Left click to apply this preset; the buttons on the right save or delete the slot.
